decision.observation: The pale ruin blocks form a long wall across the sand, with palms at left and a tall palm trunk right. Hazy green-grey mountain slopes fill the upper-left; sea glimmers through the gaps in the ruins on the right.
decision.hypothesis: The ruin wall likely has a break to pass through; the mountain mass is upper-left, so I should follow the sand leftward along the ruins rather than into them.
decision.memory: Ruins wall spans the route; mountain slopes clearly upper-left of view.
